items.title: Mastercard (MA) Opens Singapore Innovation Centre With 250 New Specialist Roles
items.summary: Mastercard (NYSE:MA) has opened its largest Asia Pacific Innovation Centre in Singapore to support regional digital commerce and AI work. The Singapore facility is set to create more than 250 specialist roles across AI, cybersecurity, and data-focused functions. The hub is designed to drive collaboration between Mastercard and partners across finance, retail, technology, and the public sector in Asia Pacific.
